notes: litert-community/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct: qwen3_coder_30b_a3b_mixed_int4_ekv4096.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct at revision b2cff646 (Apache-2.0), Qwen's coding model with tool calling (48 layers of 128 SiLU experts, 8 per token; non-thinking only), text in, text out; written with the LiteRT Tensor API (LiteRT dcb657e8 with a small patch in the conversion scripts): each layer's experts one TFLite custom op moe with SiLU and int4 blockwise-32 weights, attention and lm_head int8 per channel, fp32 activations declared, KV cache 4,096 tokens; packed with litert-lm-builder 0.19.0; the source's chat template rewritten for typed content parts, the checkpoint's tokenizer.json byte for byte, generic_model with a tool_call_config. The moe op with SiLU is in two open LiteRT pull requests (#11192 GPU, #11188 XNNPACK); LiteRT-LM 0.19.1 from PyPI refuses it on both backends, as these two records show; the numbers of the LiteRT-LM built from source with LiteRT #11192 and #11188 (the repo card's Performance and Accuracy tables) are not records: that build has no frame here. Mac Studio rows only: the file is 20.65 GB and no phone was tried. Landed 2026-11-09: litert-community/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct is public and ungated (license apache-2.0, base_model Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct quantized, library_name litert-lm), upload commit a8f3776a (2026-11-09 06:26 JST, both files), main 55d1e40d06 (the card commit, 2026-11-09T08:59:48.000Z) at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of qwen3_coder_30b_a3b_mixed_int4_ekv4096.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 20650152640 B.
quantization: decoder written with the LiteRT Tensor API from the bf16 checkpoint: each layer's 128 experts in one custom op moe with int4 blockwise-32 weights (fp32 block scales, floored at 2^-14; the form LiteRT #11309's quantizer writes for this op, made with ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.0's functions), attention q / k / v / o and the output layer int8 per channel, router, norms and token table fp32; declared fp32 activations; fp32 KV cache of 4,096 tokens; signatures prefill_128, prefill_1024 and decode
